summary: ACSM places the danger zone lower (about -8 F, frostbite within 30 min) and stresses wind and wet clothing; 0 F is slightly more conservative. Fine as a safety margin.

sources.note: ACSM sheet: avoid exercise below about -8 F; frostbite possible within 30 min
ACSM 2021 cold-injury consensus: risk rises with wind, wet clothing and stops; moving keeps skin warm
